Saxophonist Bobby Militello was born in Buffalo, NY on May 29, 1950. He has performed with Maynard Ferguson and Bill Holman and currently is a member of the Dave Brubeck Quartet. Bobby is also the owner of Buffalo’s premier jazz club, The Tralfadamore Café.
Bobby was interviewed in Buffalo, New York on October 14, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
